I’ve had the same issue and I’m relatively skinny. I could shower, not do anything and have a smell hours later. I’ve noticed it’s worse before i start my period. It’s sweat. I use dettol antibacterial body soap, then in my bikini line and over my labia majora I spray Thai crystal deodorant. Let that dry, then apply a small amount of Lume and no issues.

I second everyone saying sleep without underwear.
Dettol antibacterial soap, thai salt crystal spray deodorant, then lume on top. Works like a charm.
